interfacePlanning.checkoutInput: Follow the 07 §3 BillingAdapter shape: internal accountId and productCode, returnUrl, idempotencyKey. The server environment maps an internal productCode to that environment's provider priceId; the client does not supply/derive priceId or decide entitlement.
interfacePlanning.verifiedWebhookInput: Pass the original rawBody bytes and headers to signature verification before parsing/re-serialization; event identity is unique per provider.
interfacePlanning.contractProjection: A verified event is recorded with its projection job transactionally; provider contract lookup occurs outside the database transaction/lock. Project from the verified provider contract plus event, not arrival order alone.
interfacePlanning.entitlementBoundary: Only the T26 trusted channel contract/event projection can change Entitlement. Checkout redirect, browser callback, client isPro flag, and unverified webhook data cannot grant access.
interfacePlanning.fixedMoneyRepresentation: Integer minor units plus ISO currency; UI renders server-provided displayPrice and does not calculate a price from priceId.
interfacePlanning.fixedUnknownHandling: Unknown product or event enters restricted review/quarantine and grants no entitlement.
interfacePlanning.fixedOfflineBoundary: A valid signed cached entitlement can be displayed for offline use; after expiry the client cannot claim continuing cloud entitlement. Local functionality remains distinct.
openProtocolDetails: Exact Stripe event allowlist, webhook acknowledgement/error codes, signature tolerance, replay retention, retry and quarantine workflow.
Return URL allowlist values and URL canonicalization rules.
Stripe SDK/version and provider-specific idempotency semantics.
Exact T26 projection fields, plan-to-entitlement values, refund/grace mapping, and HTTP error details.
